description: Profile 'off' is accidentally selected for a matter tagged 'sensitive'. The privacy-filter-required guardrail must escalate.
input_text: Draft an engagement letter for privileged client Alpha Corp.
detection: Any guardrail with requires_privacy_filter: true checks the active profile and fires escalation if 'off'.
recovery: Set profile to 'cloud-only' or 'always', or remove the sensitive tag from the matter.
